description: This PHP source file defines the class smpl_Quote_Group_Sample, which generates a formatted HTML template for a quote PDF, including methods to retrieve the template content, header, and footer. It references external classes and functions for translation, URL retrieval, and global variables.

classes.name: smpl_Quote_Group_Sample
classes.description: A class responsible for generating an HTML template for quote PDFs, including methods for template body, header, and footer.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of object, which is 'AOS_Quotes'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the complete HTML content of the quote PDF including company info, quote details, and itemized line items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string as header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML for the footer, including page number and date.
